entries.body:
TFI Based on the source code of STAR CONTROL II
(STAR CONTROL is a trademark of Stardock)
entries.source:
Based on the source code of STAR CONTROL II
(STAR CONTROL is a trademark of Stardock)
entries.translation:
改編自《星際控制 II》的原始碼
（《星際控制》是 Stardock 的商標）

entries.label: Text fade-in
entries.body:
TFI Originally Created by
Fred Ford and Paul Reiche III
in 1992
entries.source:
Originally Created by
Fred Ford and Paul Reiche III
in 1992
entries.translation:
最初由
Fred Ford 與 Paul Reiche III
於 1992 年創作

entries.label: Text fade-in
entries.body:
TFI Set free into the Open Source community
in 2002. Enhanced in 2012.
entries.source:
Set free into the Open Source community
in 2002. Enhanced in 2012.
entries.translation:
2002 年向開放原始碼社群釋出
2012 年強化。

entries.body: TFI There were many great battles...
entries.source: There were many great battles...
entries.translation: 曾經發生許多偉大戰役……

entries.label: Text fade-in
entries.body:
TFI Earth and her partners in the
Alliance of Free Stars...
entries.source:
Earth and her partners in the
Alliance of Free Stars...
entries.translation:
地球與自由星辰聯盟的
夥伴……

entries.label: Text fade-in
entries.body:
TFI Against the evil Ur-Quan and its
Hierarchy of Battle Thralls.
entries.source:
Against the evil Ur-Quan and its
Hierarchy of Battle Thralls.
entries.translation:
對抗邪惡的烏爾關及其
戰奴階序。

entries.label: Text fade-in
entries.source: ...and the Ur-Quan were winning...
entries.translation: ……而烏爾關正節節勝 利……

entries.label: Text fade-in
entries.body:
TFI Meanwhile, on the edge of the
known frontier, an amazing
discovery was made...
entries.source:
Meanwhile, on the edge of the
known frontier, an amazing
discovery was made...
entries.translation:
與此同時，在已知
邊疆的盡頭，出現了一項
驚人發現……

entries.label: Text fade-in
entries.body:
TFI far beneath the surface of an
unexplored, alien world...
entries.source:
far beneath the surface of an
unexplored, alien world...
entries.translation:
就在一顆未經探索的
外星世界地表深處……

entries.label: Fade slide to black; param1=fade time
Text fade-in
entries.source: A huge underground city...
entries.translation: 一座龐大的地下城市……

entries.label: Text fade-in
entries.body:
TFI Filled with the technological
wonders of an advanced alien
race, the Precursors...
entries.source:
Filled with the technological
wonders of an advanced alien
race, the Precursors...
entries.translation:
裡面充滿先進外星
種族先驅者留下的科技
奇觀……

entries.label: Text fade-in
entries.body:
TFI Who vanished a thousand
centuries ago.
entries.source:
Who vanished a thousand
centuries ago.
entries.translation:
他們早在一千個
世紀前便已消失。

entries.label: Text fade-in
entries.body:
TFI But then the main Ur-Quan fleet
broke through the Alliance's
defensive line...
entries.source:
But then the main Ur-Quan fleet
broke through the Alliance's
defensive line...
entries.translation:
但接著，烏爾關主力艦隊
突破了聯盟的
防線……

entries.label: Text fade-in
entries.body:
TFI Isolating the planet, stranding
the scientists a hundred light
years away from Earth.
entries.source:
Isolating the planet, stranding
the scientists a hundred light
years away from Earth.
entries.translation:
行星遭到孤立，科學家
受困在距地球一百
光年之外。

entries.label: Text fade-in
entries.body:
TFI They waited hopefully for a
rescue vessel...
entries.source:
They waited hopefully for a
rescue vessel...
entries.translation:
他們滿懷希望，等待
救援船隻……

entries.label: Text fade-in
entries.source: which never came.
entries.translation: 但救援從未到來。

entries.label: Fade slide to black; param1=fade time
Text fade-in
entries.source: 20 years have passed...
entries.translation: 二十年過去了……

entries.label: Text fade-in
entries.body:
TFI We, the survivors of the research
mission have colonized this world.
entries.source:
We, the survivors of the research
mission have colonized this world.
entries.translation:
我們這些研究任務的
倖存者已在此殖民。

entries.label: Text fade-in
entries.body:
TFI We continued our investigation of
the underground city...
entries.source:
We continued our investigation of
the underground city...
entries.translation:
我們繼續調查
地下城市……

entries.label: Text fade-in
entries.body:
TFI And we have discovered its
purpose...
entries.source:
And we have discovered its
purpose...
entries.translation:
也發現了它的
用途……

entries.label: Text fade-in
entries.source: It is a factory.
entries.translation: 那是一座工廠。

entries.label: Fade slide to black; param1=fade time
Text fade-in
entries.body: TFI A factory for building starships!
entries.source: A factory for building starships!
entries.translation: 一座建造星艦的工廠！

entries.label: Text fade-in
entries.body:
TFI But there aren't enough materials
to make a complete vessel.
entries.source:
But there aren't enough materials
to make a complete vessel.
entries.translation:
但材料不足，無法
造出完整船隻。

entries.label: Text fade-in
entries.body:
TFI We can finish only the skeleton
of one starship.
entries.source:
We can finish only the skeleton
of one starship.
entries.translation:
我們只能完成一艘星艦的
骨架。

entries.label: Text fade-in
entries.body: TFI But that must be enough --
entries.source: But that must be enough --
entries.translation: 但那必須足夠——

entries.label: Text fade-in
entries.body:
TFI Because YOU must captain the
vessel...
entries.source:
Because YOU must captain the
vessel...
entries.translation:
因為你必須指揮這艘
船……

entries.label: Text fade-in
entries.source: And return to Earth!
entries.translation: 並返回地球！

entries.label: Fade slide to black; param1=fade time
Text fade-in
entries.body:
TFI To travel the great distance,
you must push through into
HyperSpace...
entries.source:
To travel the great distance,
you must push through into
HyperSpace...
entries.translation:
要跨越漫長距離
你必須奮力進入
超空間……

entries.label: Text fade-in
entries.body:
TFI Find out what has happened over
these many years...
entries.source:
Find out what has happened over
these many years...
entries.translation:
查明這麼多年來
發生了什麼事……

entries.label: Text fade-in
entries.body: TFI Tell Earth of our plight!
entries.source: Tell Earth of our plight!
entries.translation: 告訴地球我們的困境！

entries.label: Text fade-in
entries.body:
TFI And if the war with the Ur-Quan
still rages...
entries.source:
And if the war with the Ur-Quan
still rages...
entries.translation:
而若對抗烏爾關的戰爭
仍未平息……

entries.label: Text fade-in
entries.body:
TFI Fight for Earth and the Alliance,
as well as you can...
entries.source:
Fight for Earth and the Alliance,
as well as you can...
entries.translation:
就竭盡所能，為地球和聯盟
而戰……

entries.label: Fade slide to black; param1=fade time
